chk_background_jobs_lease.name: chk_background_jobs_lease
chk_background_jobs_lease.value: (`background_jobs`.`state` = 'RUNNING' AND `background_jobs`.`locked_at` IS NOT NULL AND `background_jobs`.`heartbeat_at` IS NOT NULL AND `background_jobs`.`locked_until` IS NOT NULL AND `background_jobs`.`worker_id` IS NOT NULL AND `background_jobs`.`lease_epoch` > 0 AND `background_jobs`.`locked_at` <= `background_jobs`.`heartbeat_at` AND `background_jobs`.`heartbeat_at` < `background_jobs`.`locked_until`) OR (`background_jobs`.`state` <> 'RUNNING' AND `background_jobs`.`locked_at` IS NULL AND `background_jobs`.`heartbeat_at` IS NULL AND `background_jobs`.`locked_until` IS NULL AND `background_jobs`.`worker_id` IS NULL)

chk_background_jobs_terminal.name: chk_background_jobs_terminal
chk_background_jobs_terminal.value: (`background_jobs`.`state` IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND `background_jobs`.`finished_at` IS NOT NULL AND `background_jobs`.`finished_at` >= `background_jobs`.`created_at`) OR (`background_jobs`.`state` NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND `background_jobs`.`finished_at` IS NULL)

chk_background_jobs_failure.name: chk_background_jobs_failure
chk_background_jobs_failure.value: (`background_jobs`.`state` IN ('FAILED','RETRY_WAIT') AND `background_jobs`.`last_failure_code` IS NOT NULL) OR (`background_jobs`.`state` IN ('QUEUED','SUCCEEDED','CANCELLED') AND `background_jobs`.`last_failure_code` IS NULL) OR `background_jobs`.`state` = 'RUNNING'

chk_derived_assets_reservation.name: chk_derived_assets_reservation
chk_derived_assets_reservation.value: (`derived_assets`.`kind` = 'THUMBNAIL' AND `derived_assets`.`reserved_bytes` BETWEEN 1 AND 524288) OR (`derived_assets`.`kind` = 'PREVIEW' AND `derived_assets`.`reserved_bytes` BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304) OR (`derived_assets`.`kind` = 'VIDEO_POSTER' AND `derived_assets`.`reserved_bytes` BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576)

chk_derived_assets_bytes_digest.name: chk_derived_assets_bytes_digest
chk_derived_assets_bytes_digest.value: (`derived_assets`.`byte_size` IS NULL AND `derived_assets`.`sha256` IS NULL) OR (`derived_assets`.`byte_size` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`sha256` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`byte_size` > 0 AND `derived_assets`.`byte_size` <= `derived_assets`.`reserved_bytes`)

chk_derived_assets_dimensions.name: chk_derived_assets_dimensions
chk_derived_assets_dimensions.value: (`derived_assets`.`width` IS NULL AND `derived_assets`.`height` IS NULL) OR (`derived_assets`.`width` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`height` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`width` > 0 AND `derived_assets`.`height` > 0)

chk_derived_assets_published_payload.name: chk_derived_assets_published_payload
chk_derived_assets_published_payload.value: `derived_assets`.`state` NOT IN ('PUBLISHING','READY') OR (`derived_assets`.`byte_size` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`sha256` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`width` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`height` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`output_mime` = 'image/webp' AND `derived_assets`.`producer_lease_epoch` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`producer_lease_epoch` > 0)

chk_derived_assets_ready.name: chk_derived_assets_ready
chk_derived_assets_ready.value: `derived_assets`.`state` <> 'READY' OR (`derived_assets`.`published_at` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_assets`.`cleaned_at` IS NULL AND `derived_assets`.`published_at` >= `derived_assets`.`created_at`)

chk_derived_assets_failure.name: chk_derived_assets_failure
chk_derived_assets_failure.value: (`derived_assets`.`state` IN ('MISSING','FAILED') AND `derived_assets`.`failure_code` IS NOT NULL) OR (`derived_assets`.`state` NOT IN ('MISSING','FAILED') AND `derived_assets`.`failure_code` IS NULL)

chk_derived_assets_times.name: chk_derived_assets_times
chk_derived_assets_times.value: (`derived_assets`.`published_at` IS NULL OR `derived_assets`.`published_at` >= `derived_assets`.`created_at`) AND (`derived_assets`.`cleaned_at` IS NULL OR `derived_assets`.`cleaned_at` >= `derived_assets`.`created_at`)

chk_invitations_used_pair.name: chk_invitations_used_pair
chk_invitations_used_pair.value: (`invitations`.`used_at` IS NULL AND `invitations`.`used_by_member_id` IS NULL) OR (`invitations`.`used_at` IS NOT NULL AND `invitations`.`used_by_member_id` IS NOT NULL)

chk_invitations_used_or_revoked.name: chk_invitations_used_or_revoked
chk_invitations_used_or_revoked.value: NOT (`invitations`.`used_at` IS NOT NULL AND `invitations`.`revoked_at` IS NOT NULL)

chk_invitations_revoker_requires_revoked.name: chk_invitations_revoker_requires_revoked_at
chk_invitations_revoker_requires_revoked.value: `invitations`.`revoked_by_member_id` IS NULL OR `invitations`.`revoked_at` IS NOT NULL

chk_media_items_raw_dimensions.name: chk_media_items_raw_dimensions
chk_media_items_raw_dimensions.value: (`media_items`.`raw_width` IS NULL AND `media_items`.`raw_height` IS NULL) OR (`media_items`.`raw_width` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`raw_height` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`raw_width` > 0 AND `media_items`.`raw_height` > 0)

chk_media_items_display_dimensions.name: chk_media_items_display_dimensions
chk_media_items_display_dimensions.value: (`media_items`.`display_width` IS NULL AND `media_items`.`display_height` IS NULL) OR (`media_items`.`display_width` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`display_height` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`display_width` > 0 AND `media_items`.`display_height` > 0)

chk_media_items_gps.name: chk_media_items_gps
chk_media_items_gps.value: (`media_items`.`gps_latitude` IS NULL AND `media_items`.`gps_longitude` IS NULL) OR (`media_items`.`gps_latitude` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`gps_longitude` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`gps_latitude` BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND `media_items`.`gps_longitude` BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

chk_media_items_capture.name: chk_media_items_capture
chk_media_items_capture.value: (`media_items`.`captured_time_status` = 'ABSENT' AND `media_items`.`captured_source` = 'NONE' AND `media_items`.`captured_local_at` IS NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_at_utc` IS NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_offset_minutes` IS NULL) OR (`media_items`.`captured_time_status` = 'OFFSET_UNKNOWN' AND `media_items`.`captured_source` <> 'NONE' AND `media_items`.`captured_local_at` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_at_utc` IS NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_offset_minutes` IS NULL) OR (`media_items`.`captured_time_status` = 'OFFSET_KNOWN' AND `media_items`.`captured_source` <> 'NONE' AND `media_items`.`captured_local_at` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_at_utc` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_offset_minutes` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`captured_offset_minutes` BETWEEN -840 AND 840 AND (ABS(`media_items`.`captured_offset_minutes`) < 840 OR MOD(`media_items`.`captured_offset_minutes`,60) = 0))

chk_media_items_timeline.name: chk_media_items_timeline
chk_media_items_timeline.value: (`media_items`.`timeline_basis` = 'CAPTURE_LOCAL' AND `media_items`.`captured_local_at` IS NOT NULL AND `media_items`.`timeline_key` = `media_items`.`captured_local_at`) OR (`media_items`.`timeline_basis` = 'UPLOAD_UTC' AND `media_items`.`timeline_key` = `media_items`.`uploaded_at`)

chk_media_items_failure.name: chk_media_items_failure
chk_media_items_failure.value: (`media_items`.`processing_state` IN ('FAILED','BLOCKED') AND `media_items`.`last_failure_code` IS NOT NULL) OR (`media_items`.`processing_state` NOT IN ('FAILED','BLOCKED') AND (`media_items`.`processing_state` = 'PARTIAL' OR `media_items`.`last_failure_code` IS NULL))

chk_sessions_revoked_pair.name: chk_sessions_revoked_pair
chk_sessions_revoked_pair.value: (`sessions`.`revoked_at` IS NULL AND `sessions`.`revoke_reason` IS NULL) OR (`sessions`.`revoked_at` IS NOT NULL AND `sessions`.`revoke_reason` IS NOT NULL)

chk_upload_sessions_finalize_pair.name: chk_upload_sessions_finalize_pair
chk_upload_sessions_finalize_pair.value: (`upload_sessions`.`computed_sha256` IS NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NULL) OR (`upload_sessions`.`computed_sha256` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NOT NULL)

chk_upload_sessions_finalize_state.name: chk_upload_sessions_finalize_state
chk_upload_sessions_finalize_state.value: (`upload_sessions`.`state` IN ('FINALIZING','COMPLETE') AND `upload_sessions`.`computed_sha256` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`committed_offset` = `upload_sessions`.`declared_size`) OR (`upload_sessions`.`state` IN ('CREATED','UPLOADING','ABORTED','EXPIRED') AND `upload_sessions`.`computed_sha256` IS NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NULL) OR (`upload_sessions`.`state` = 'FAILED' AND ((`upload_sessions`.`computed_sha256` IS NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NULL) OR (`upload_sessions`.`computed_sha256` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`committed_offset` = `upload_sessions`.`declared_size`)))

chk_upload_sessions_complete.name: chk_upload_sessions_complete
chk_upload_sessions_complete.value: (`upload_sessions`.`state` = 'COMPLETE' AND `upload_sessions`.`storage_object_id` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`completed_at` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`terminal_at` IS NULL) OR (`upload_sessions`.`state` <> 'COMPLETE' AND `upload_sessions`.`storage_object_id` IS NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`completed_at` IS NULL)

chk_upload_sessions_terminal.name: chk_upload_sessions_terminal
chk_upload_sessions_terminal.value: (`upload_sessions`.`state` IN ('FAILED','ABORTED','EXPIRED') AND `upload_sessions`.`terminal_at` IS NOT NULL) OR (`upload_sessions`.`state` NOT IN ('FAILED','ABORTED','EXPIRED') AND `upload_sessions`.`terminal_at` IS NULL)

chk_upload_sessions_failure.name: chk_upload_sessions_failure
chk_upload_sessions_failure.value: (`upload_sessions`.`state` = 'FAILED' AND `upload_sessions`.`failure_code` IS NOT NULL) OR (`upload_sessions`.`state` <> 'FAILED' AND `upload_sessions`.`failure_code` IS NULL)

chk_upload_sessions_times.name: chk_upload_sessions_times
chk_upload_sessions_times.value: (`upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NULL OR `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` >= `upload_sessions`.`created_at`) AND (`upload_sessions`.`completed_at` IS NULL OR `upload_sessions`.`completed_at` >= `upload_sessions`.`created_at`) AND (`upload_sessions`.`terminal_at` IS NULL OR `upload_sessions`.`terminal_at` >= `upload_sessions`.`created_at`) AND (`upload_sessions`.`staging_cleaned_at` IS NULL OR `upload_sessions`.`staging_cleaned_at` >= `upload_sessions`.`created_at`) AND (`upload_sessions`.`completed_at` IS NULL OR (`upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at` IS NOT NULL AND `upload_sessions`.`completed_at` >= `upload_sessions`.`finalize_started_at`)) AND (`upload_sessions`.`staging_cleaned_at` IS NULL OR `upload_sessions`.`state` IN ('COMPLETE','FAILED','ABORTED','EXPIRED'))

password_hash.name: password_hash
password_hash.type: varchar(255) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
